system.description:
While driving a personal vehicle with an armor module enabled, a Pilot does not have access to the normal contents of their armor slot. Instead, that slot is considered occupied by the personal vehicle's armor module. If the personal vehicle has no armor module enabled, the Pilot can keep using their equipped armor as normal.

  • As soon as the Pilot stops driving a personal vehicle with an enabled armor module, they immediately regain access to their normal equipped armor.

  • Armor modules marked with @ICON[martial] are considered to be martial armor for the sake of Skills and other effects, and they set the Pilot's Defense and Magic Defense to fixed scores (bonuses from shields and other effects still apply). Note that a Pilot can still equip these modules even if they normally lack the ability to equip martial armor.

For instance, a Pilot with the Guardian Class benefits from the Defensive Mastery Skill while driving a personal vehicle with a Heavy Plating module enabled, but they do not benefit from the Dodge Skill granted by the Rogue Class.
